Boundary: Native host identity, Hyper-V, lab credentials and PowerShell Direct are mocked in Pester. TestDrive snapshot/export bytes and private user-scope journal files are real. Source parsing/selected-image decoding and installed-configuration Prepare preview are real and read-only.
ExportBoundary: Correlated fixed remote collection; 512-entry, 16-MiB per-file and 32-MiB aggregate limits; traversal/duplicate/reparse/digest refusal; independent host digest readback and private receipt.
ResetBoundary: Only explicit Reset exports then restores the pinned checkpoint, verifies Off, writes a correlated receipt and releases the hold. Off retry requires a saved pre-reset intent and reverified exported bytes. Native/visual acceptance is never inferred.
FailureBoundary: Guest and hold retained; failed guest phases attempt partial export. Early preparation failures without a descriptor or VM intent require controller recovery inspection. Job timeout is not proof every guest activity stopped. Host dependency/Hyper-V calls do not gain an independent watchdog.
